data.define: To wear many layers because it's cold.

misuse.text: Don't tell a friend to 'bundle up' in summer.
misuse.why: It means put on warm clothes.

data.l1_hook: إنه بارد جدًا في الخارج. هل أنت مستعد؟ "bundle up"
data.l1_ex: "Bundle up"، الجو بارد جدًا في الخارج!

native.tip: “bundle up” = ارتدِ ملابس دافئة. مثال: “Bundle up, it's freezing outside!”
